tools.name: merge_duplicate_ticket_and_transfer_owner
tools.description: Merges a duplicate support ticket into a primary ticket by moving its comments over, then deletes the duplicate ticket and makes the primary ticket's assignee the owner of the merged ticket.

params.name: duplicate_id
params.description: ID of the duplicate ticket to merge and delete

params.name: primary_id
params.description: ID of the ticket that receives the comments

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "support.db"


@tool
def merge_duplicate_ticket_and_transfer_owner(duplicate_id: int, primary_id: int) -> str:
    if duplicate_id == primary_id:
        return "Cannot merge a ticket into itself"
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        with conn:
            primary = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, assignee_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (primary_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            duplicate = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, assignee_id FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (duplicate_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if primary is None or duplicate is None:
                return "One or both tickets were not found"
            moved = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE ticket_comments SET ticket_id = ? WHERE ticket_id = ?",
                (primary_id, duplicate_id),
            ).rowcount
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE ticket_access SET ticket_id = ? WHERE ticket_id = ?",
                (primary_id, duplicate_id),
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (duplicate_id,))
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE tickets SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (primary[1], primary_id),
            )
    return f"Merged ticket {duplicate_id} into {primary_id}; moved {moved} comments"

tools.name: issue_goodwill_credit_and_grant_portal_access
tools.description: Issues a goodwill refund to the customer for a support ticket through Stripe and grants the customer's contact access to the ticket in the support portal.

params.name: contact_id
params.description: Portal contact ID to receive access

tools.code:
import stripe
import requests

PORTAL_URL = "https://portal.internal.example.com/api"


def issue_goodwill_credit_and_grant_portal_access(ticket_id: str, charge_id: str, amount_cents: int, contact_id: str) -> dict:
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(
        charge=charge_id,
        amount=amount_cents,
        metadata={"ticket_id": ticket_id, "reason": "goodwill"},
    )
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{PORTAL_URL}/tickets/{ticket_id}/access",
        json={"contact_id": contact_id, "level": "viewer"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    result = {
        "ticket_id": ticket_id,
        "refund_id": refund.id,
        "refund_status": refund.status,
        "amount_cents": amount_cents,
        "access_granted": resp.ok,
    }
    return result

tools.name: archive_resolved_tickets
tools.description: Moves resolved tickets older than a given number of days into the archive table, removes them from the active tickets table, and updates the archive log with the count.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Minimum age in days since resolution

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("support-tickets")
DB_PATH = "support.db"


@mcp.tool()
def archive_resolved_tickets(older_than_days: int) -> str:
    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO tickets_archive SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE status = 'resolved' AND resolved_at < ?",
        (cutoff,),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "DELETE FROM tickets WHERE status = 'resolved' AND resolved_at < ?",
        (cutoff,),
    )
    count = cur.rowcount
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO archive_log (run_at, ticket_count, cutoff) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), count, cutoff),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return f"Archived {count} resolved tickets older than {older_than_days} days"

tools.name: export_ticket_attachments_to_case_folder
tools.description: Looks up a ticket's attachments in the database and moves the files from the shared inbox folder into a per-ticket case folder. Returns the list of moved file names.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: ID of the ticket whose attachments should be moved

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "support.db"
INBOX_DIR = Path("/srv/support/inbox")
CASES_DIR = Path("/srv/support/cases")


@function_tool
def export_ticket_attachments_to_case_folder(ticket_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT filename FROM attachments WHERE ticket_id = ?", (ticket_id,)
    ).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    case_dir = CASES_DIR / f"ticket_{ticket_id}"
    case_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    moved = []
    for (filename,) in rows:
        source = INBOX_DIR / filename
        shutil.move(str(source), str(case_dir / filename))
        moved.append(filename)
    return f"Moved {len(moved)} files to {case_dir}: {', '.join(moved)}"
